institution.name: John Jay College of Criminal Justice

plan.notes: Source: John Jay College of Criminal Justice official "CRIMINOLOGY FOUR YEAR ADVISEMENT PLAN", Academic Advisement Center, Revised 3/12/25 (jjay.cuny.edu). No explicit catalog year is printed on the plan; filed as 2025-2026 per the revision date, disclosed here. The plan marks this as one sample combination of requirements ("just one possible way to combine your requirements" per the college advisement pages). Transcribed exactly as published: 8 terms x 15 credits = 120, matching the published Curriculum Summary (Gen Ed 42 + Major 42 + Electives 36 = 120). Unnamed slots transcribed as choice slots with the plan literal as title and choice_note; options lists for Part Two / Part Three / Part Four Multi-Disciplinary courses verified against the official Criminology BA bulletin page (jjay.smartcatalogiq.com). Course titles for SOC 101, MAT 108, SOC 203, SOC 213, SOC 314, SSC 325, STA 250, SOC 440 verified against the official major bulletin page and the official CRIMINOLOGY Major Worksheet (Fall 2017 and later, updated June 2024). Prerequisites recorded only where the official worksheet states them (SOC 203: SOC 101 & ENG 101; SOC 314: ENG 201, SOC 101, junior standing; STA 250: ENG 101, MAT 108/141; SSC 325: ENG 201, SOC 101, junior standing; SOC 440: ENG 201, senior standing, all Part One disciplinary requirements). WINTER/SUMMER columns on the plan are empty (all coursework is Fall/Spring). Degree type BA confirmed on the plan.
